result.instructions: Tools for SatisMeter, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "What is our NPS score for the last 30 days?"; "Which of our surveys are live right now?"; "What was the response rate of the CSAT survey last month?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes SatisMeter data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run satismeter_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run satismeter_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run satismeter_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. satismeter_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: satismeter_get_project
tools.title: Get project
tools.description: Get the SatisMeter project this key belongs to (id and name). Good first call to check the connection. SatisMeter API: GET /api/v3/projects/{projectId}.

tools.name: satismeter_list_surveys
tools.title: List surveys
tools.description: List every survey (campaign) in the project with its id, name, type (for example nps, csat or ces) and state (for example live or draft). Use the id with the other survey tools. SatisMeter API: GET /api/v3/projects/{projectId}/campaigns.

tools.name: satismeter_get_survey
tools.title: Get survey
tools.description: Get one survey by id: its name, type and state. SatisMeter API: GET /api/v3/projects/{projectId}/campaigns/{campaignId}.

tools.name: satismeter_list_responses
tools.title: List responses (all surveys)
tools.description: List responses recorded in any survey of the project within a date window. Each response holds its answers, the survey id, and the respondent and device details, which can include personal data (name, email). Returns data and page.nextPageCursor. SatisMeter API: GET /api/v3/projects/{projectId}/responses.

start_date.description: Start of the window, ISO 8601 date-time (for example 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z). Default: 30 days ago.

end_date.description: End of the window, ISO 8601 date-time (for example 2026-10-31T23:59:59Z). Default: now.

page_cursor.description: Cursor for the next page: pass the page.nextPageCursor value of the previous reply.

tools.name: satismeter_list_survey_responses
tools.title: List responses (one survey)
tools.description: List responses recorded in one survey. Each response holds its answers, the respondent and device details, which can include personal data (name, email). Returns data and page.nextPageCursor. SatisMeter API: GET /api/v3/projects/{projectId}/campaigns/{campaignId}/responses.

start_date.description: Start of the window, ISO 8601 date-time (for example 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z). Default: 30 days ago.

end_date.description: End of the window, ISO 8601 date-time (for example 2026-10-31T23:59:59Z). Default: now.

page_cursor.description: Cursor for the next page: pass the page.nextPageCursor value of the previous reply.

tools.name: satismeter_get_survey_statistics
tools.title: Get survey statistics
tools.description: Get statistics for one survey over a window: displays, responses, response rate, and the answer counts per question and score. Use it for NPS, CSAT or CES reporting. SatisMeter API: GET /api/v3/projects/{projectId}/campaigns/{campaignId}/statistics.

start_date.description: Start of the window, ISO 8601 date-time (for example 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z). Default: 30 days ago.

end_date.description: End of the window, ISO 8601 date-time (for example 2026-10-31T23:59:59Z). Default: now.
